title: Pale Ale Pizzas, Okanagan Peach
notes: Recipes created by Krissy Seymour. krissy@fraichecreations.com

ingredientSections.heading: Okanagan Peach & Smoked Prosciutto Pizza
items: 4 Slices smoked proscuitto ripped in half
Heirloom tomato and birdseye chilli sauce

methodSections.heading: Okanagan Peach & Smoked Prosciutto Pizza with Crème Fraîche & Watercress
steps: Beer Pairing: Bridge Brewing Wunderbar Kolsh.
Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Generously cover the flatbread with tomato sauce.
Mix the peach slices with the sweet chili sauce and scatter over the flatbread with the prosciutto and sliced red onion. Place dollops of the farmers cheese evenly over the flatbread.
Place straight on oven rack and bake for 10 minutes or until crisp at edges. Leave to cool for 5 minutes on a wire cooling rack. Top with crème fraîche, watercress and black pepper.
